thread:
olivia: Quick heads-up — doing a last-minute RN dry run. Can folks confirm the pinned model version for the release?
ram: pinging — we had discussed pinning to v2.1.3-quant for latency. any objections?
sara: v2.1.3-quant looks good for throughput, but we should note the slight tokenization change in the RN. add a one-liner.
samir: noted. I'll add: 'Tokenizer alignment fix — minimal output diffs expected for a subset of prompts.'
jen: timezone check: deploy window is 2024-05-01 02:00-03:00 UTC, right? that hits US late evening. we need a handoff doc for APAC oncall.
olivia: yes 02:00-03:00 UTC. @samir can you own the APAC handoff doc and add the quick rollback steps?
samir: taking it — will add runbook section + rollback criteria. rollback trigger: >5% error rate or p99 latency >1.2s sustained for 10m.
ram: deploybot will post canary flags, right? want a marker to auto-fallback to v2.1.2 if canary fails.
deploybot: Deploy request received: tag=release/2024-05-01 rc-5, image=infra/redwood-runtime:2024.04.30, pinned_model=v2.1.3-quant, canary=5%, fallback_model=v2.1.2.
sara: perfect. Add to RN: canary 5% for 30m, monitoring dashboards linked, fallback policy described.
jen: internal announcement draft ready — short blurb + ops contact. I'll paste draft in a sec.
jen: "Heads up: small infra release to improve inference latency. Rolling canary at 02:00 UTC 2024-05-01, will fall back to previous model on errors. Ops: @samir @olivia on-call."
olivia: tweak to mention tokenization note? maybe: "Note: minor tokenizer alignment may change outputs for a subset of prompts; see details in RN."
jen: done. sending to #general and #customer-success after we pin and deploybot confirms canary started.
ram: preflight checklist: 1) RN published in Confluence 2) Deploybot config reviewed 3) Dashboards + alerts set 4) Post-deploy smoke test runbook owned. All set?
samir: 1) and 4) done. I'll push the smoke test snippet to the doc: `curl -X POST https://staging.api/redwood/infer -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST'`
jen: I will schedule the internal announcement for 01:30 UTC so folks know 30m before.
olivia: heads-up: if canary shows token drift but no perf regression, prefer gradual rollout and manual sign-off, not automatic fallback. Add that to RN ops notes.
ram: agreed. add manual check pass condition: semantic similarity score avg >= 0.92 on smoke prompts.
sara: finishing RN editing now. tagging THIS as RN-v1.0-final in Confluence.
deploybot: Canary started: release/2024-05-01 rc-5, canary=5% at 1715125200. Monitoring link: https://console.redwood/monitoring/runs/rc-5
samir: thanks — I'm on standby. will post immediate status at +10m and +30m.
jen: thanks team — good dry run. I'll send the pre-announce at 01:30 UTC and we reconvene in #eng-releases if anything goes sideways. :thumbsup:
